title: Unauthorized Customer-Data Export
summary: A full customer extract sits on a shared support folder. During a normal business day someone moves it out of the company. Discover and classify the data, build and test DLP controls, investigate the alerts, contain the incident, fix the root cause, prove the fix by replay and report.
briefing: You are the Data Protection Analyst at Kestrel Ridge Financial (fictional). Internal Audit flagged that bulk customer extracts are created nightly and that nobody has reviewed who can read them. Your manager has asked you to (1) find and classify customer data, (2) make sure DLP controls would stop customer data leaving through personal channels without disrupting legitimate business transfers, and (3) handle any incident that occurs during today's simulated business day. Everything here is synthetic and simulated: no real email, upload or account is affected.
objectives: Discover where customer data is stored and identify sensitive patterns with evidence.
Assign and justify classification labels; record ownership and handling requirements.
Review access to sensitive data and identify excessive permissions.
Design, test and tune a DLP policy that separates prohibited from legitimate transfers.
Triage alerts, separating true positives, benign positives and undetermined activity.
Correlate identity, file-access and DLP events and determine the supported exposure scope.
Apply proportionate containment while preserving evidence.
Fix the control gap and verify the fix by replaying the scenario.
Produce an evidence-based incident report that separates observations, inferences and unknowns.

context.business_justification: Weekly escalation queue hand-off to HelpWise
Sending published brochure to event print shop

tasks.title: Run a discovery scan across the data inventory
tasks.description: Use Data Discovery to scan every asset with the active detectors. Review which assets contain sensitive patterns.

tasks.title: Inspect the customer data assets
tasks.description: Open the detail view of customer-related assets. Review owner, location, sample content, detector evidence and access.

tasks.title: Classify assets and record ownership
tasks.description: Assign a label with justification to every asset that is unlabeled or mislabeled. Assign a data owner where one is missing.

tasks.title: Review access to sensitive data
tasks.description: Record a KEEP or REVOKE decision for the grants on the customer export. Revoking a grant is a real state change in this scenario.

tasks.title: Create or update a DLP policy
tasks.description: Use the DLP Policy Studio to create a new policy or a new version of an existing policy.

tasks.title: Test legitimate and prohibited transfers
tasks.description: Use the policy test workspace to evaluate at least one transfer that should be allowed and one that should be stopped.

tasks.title: Run the simulated business day
tasks.description: Execute the business-day timeline. Every activity is evaluated against the controls you have configured at that moment.

tasks.title: Triage every alert from the business day
tasks.description: Give each alert from run 1 a disposition with a justification.

tasks.title: Open a case and link evidence
tasks.description: Open an investigation case from the most important alert and link at least three pieces of evidence.

tasks.title: Record observations, inferences and unknowns
tasks.description: Add at least one note of each kind. Keep confirmed observations separate from conclusions.

tasks.title: Determine exposure scope and severity
tasks.description: Record affected assets, exposure status, record estimate and severity using the documented risk model.

tasks.title: Apply containment
tasks.description: Choose proportionate containment actions. Consider evidence preservation before device actions.

tasks.title: Correct the control gap
tasks.description: Fix the underlying weakness: an excessive permission, a missing classification and/or a weak policy.

tasks.title: Replay and verify the corrected outcome
tasks.description: Run a control-validation replay after your last fix. A test identity cloned from the original actor's role repeats the activity.

tasks.title: Complete the incident report
tasks.description: Write the summary, root-cause narrative, residual risk and lessons learned in the case.

discover: Data Discovery > Run scan inspects the stored content sample of every asset.
Sort findings by confidence; LOW confidence often means test values or masked data.
inspect: Look for assets whose owner or label column is empty: those are coverage gaps.
classify: Compare the scan recommendation with the business context. A recommendation is evidence, not a decision.
Check the label definitions: bulk customer PII with payment card numbers is described in one specific label.
access_review: Ask who needs bulk extracts for their job, and who merely inherited folder access.
Look at the justification text on each grant and at the membership of each group.
policy: A monitor-only policy records but never stops a transfer.
Conditions on the label only work if the asset is labeled. Content detection works even when labels are missing.
policy_test: Test both a personal destination and a sanctioned partner so you can see the business impact of your rule.
run_day: Run the day once your controls are ready, or run it first to see the baseline. Both are valid; the timeline evaluates whatever is configured.
triage: A policy can match exactly as written and still describe legitimate business activity. That is a benign positive, not necessarily a false positive.
When the evidence cannot settle a question, UNDETERMINED is a legitimate disposition.
case: Use the correlation panel in the alert view: it explains why each related event is linked.
analysis: Observation: something an event shows. Inference: what you conclude from it. Unknown: what the evidence cannot tell you.
scope: Use the risk model calculator and record which inputs you used.
contain: Some device actions destroy evidence. Check the incident procedure asset for the required order of operations.
fix: Containing one person does not fix the path that allowed the export.
verify: Replay after your last change; earlier replays do not prove later fixes.
report: Residual risk: what remains true even after your remediation?

remediation_catalog.title: Preserve endpoint and mailbox evidence
remediation_catalog.description: Create a forensic snapshot of the identity's device and place a hold on its mailbox.

remediation_catalog.title: Disable account
remediation_catalog.description: Prevent any further sign-in or data access by the identity.

remediation_catalog.title: Revoke active sessions
remediation_catalog.description: Terminate current sessions. The identity can still sign in again unless disabled.

remediation_catalog.title: Block destination at egress proxy
remediation_catalog.description: Add the destination to the egress blocklist for all users.

remediation_catalog.title: Quarantine asset
remediation_catalog.description: Move the asset to quarantine; only the owner and Security can read it.

remediation_catalog.title: Revoke access grant
remediation_catalog.description: Remove a permission from a group or identity.

remediation_catalog.title: Reimage the identity's device
remediation_catalog.description: Wipe and rebuild the endpoint. Destroys local evidence.

remediation_catalog.title: Request takedown from external provider
remediation_catalog.description: Ask the external service to remove copied data. The outcome cannot be verified inside the simulation.

remediation_catalog.title: Escalate to a stakeholder
remediation_catalog.description: Formally notify Privacy Office, Legal, HR, the data owner or management.

remediation_catalog.title: Re-enable account
remediation_catalog.description: Restore access for an identity that was disabled in error.

policy_test_suite.description: Contract agent uploads full customer export to personal cloud
Support agent emails full customer export to personal webmail

Marketing uploads public brochure to personal cloud for a print shop
Support manager exports 2,500 customers to HelpWise SFTP with ticket
Contract agent copies customer export to USB
HR partner emails HR records to personal webmail
Administrator uploads integration secrets file to personal cloud
Data owner uploads masked sample to corporate cloud
Support manager emails response macros internally
Finance manager emails pricing model to personal webmail
Support agent pastes customer export into unapproved public AI chat
Support manager asks the approved internal AI assistant to summarise macros
Payroll specialist emails payroll register to personal webmail

criteria.description: Customer export classified at the correct sensitivity
Other unlabeled or mislabeled assets classified correctly
Excessive permission on the customer export removed
Exfiltration-related alerts identified as true positives
Legitimate business activity recognised (benign or false positive)
Ambiguous activity not over-concluded without evidence
Case determination and subject identity supported by evidence
Severity consistent with the documented risk model
Case links the download, the transfer and the access path
Observations cite evidence; inferences and unknowns are recorded separately
Replay shows the exfiltration path is closed
Replay shows legitimate business activity still works
DLP policy independently prevents customer data reaching personal destinations (defence in depth)
Subject identity contained and containment verified
Personal-data incident escalated to Privacy Office or Legal
Incident report fields complete and root causes identified

critical_conditions.description: The subject's device was reimaged before evidence was preserved.
No control-validation replay after the last fix shows the exfiltration path closed.
